problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments into identical cargo vehicles. Shipments include:
* Component Alpha: mass 66 units
* Component Beta: mass 51 units
* Component Gamma: mass 45 units
* Component Delta: mass 67 units
* Component Epsilon: mass 64 units
* Component Zeta: mass 52 units
* Component Eta: mass 40 units
* Component Theta: mass 39 units
* Component Iota: mass 51 units
* Component Kappa: mass 30 units
* Component Lambda: mass 67 units
* Component Mu: mass 33 units
* Component Nu: mass 66 units
* Component Xi: mass 39 units
* Component Omicron: mass 52 units
* Component Pi: mass 53 units
* Component Rho: mass 48 units
* Component Sigma: mass 70 units
* Component Tau: mass 48 units

Each cargo vehicle can carry a maximum load of 100 units. All shipments must be assigned to exactly one vehicle, and the cumulative mass in any vehicle must not surpass its capacity. Determine an allocation that minimizes the total number of vehicles required.
